name: play-safeguards
skills: Psychology of small-stakes games of chance: who spends more than they can afford in raffles and prize draws, which game features drive it (near-miss messages, frequent draws, big single prizes, easy repeat buying), and which safeguards worked in trials: ticket caps per household, spending limits, cooling-off, donation framing.
examples: How do we protect residents who spend too much on our raffle?
Does a cap on tickets per household cost us much revenue?
Should our prize draw tell players how close they were to winning?
